ENGLISH MARCH — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ENGLISH MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. Only an action
   C. Only a describing word
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

2. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading.

3. When practising Critical Listening ● finding connections between ideas or incidents , cause-effe, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   A. No full stops
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

6. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Extensive Listening ● listening for enjoyment and g, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Extensive Listening ● listening for enjoyment and g.
